reference_use: Read and visually inspected; new-image prompts describe their art direction. No game assets modified.
processing: Mechanical downsampling with System.Drawing HighQualityBicubic, preserving generated alpha. No color edits, sharpening, background removal, or painted content generated with code.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE isolated painted game sprite for SIGIL: BREACH, a living dark chapel fresco. A square transparent PNG with genuine alpha, no backdrop. Match aged egg-tempera fresco: matte chalky ochre, umber, subdued iron/madder red, warm old ivory, hand-painted dark brown contour, broad quiet pigment planes and very sparse dry-brush wear. Shallow medieval painted volume, no gloss. This is a functional tiny HUD mark on light parchment: instantly readable at 18 pixels. Strong simple silhouette, thick continuous umber outline, very few internal details, no hairlines. Centered single object occupying 85 percent of square, all parts contained, even clear margin. No surrounding medallion or frame. No text, letters, numerals, runes, labels, skulls, faces, glow, specular highlights, sparkles, plastic, modern vector art, floor, cast shadow or scenery. Do not imitate photographic glass or metallic reflections. Subject: A squat glass healing flask with a short narrow neck and ochre cork, round broad shoulders and flattened base. Filled three quarters with muted deep madder-red healing liquid, ONE clearly visible horizontal liquid level. Thick pale grey-ivory glass border with dark umber outer contour; opaque matte painted treatment. Plain flask, no seal, no ribbon. Final delivered asset will be reduced to 64x64 pixels.

images.edit_prompt: Edit this SIGIL: BREACH ammunition pickup sprite. Preserve its exact compact tied paper packet composition, silhouette, brown twine, knot, bullet arrangement, ochre paper, umber contours, transparent background and painted fresco style. Change ONLY the metallic cartridge surfaces: remove ALL white and pale specular streaks, hotspots and glossy reflective appearance from bullet noses and brass casings. Repaint as quiet flat matte umber and subdued ochre pigment planes with restrained soft broad modeling. Tarnished chalky egg tempera, absolutely no metal shine. Keep recognizable rounded bullet noses. No text, skulls, glow, scenery or shadows. Genuine transparent background.

limitations: Widocznosc paczek z 6–8 m nie zostala sprawdzona w silniku; sheet.png pokazuje probe 48 px na rzeczywistej ciemnej posadzce z referencji.
Detale materialu i pieczeci redukuja sie przy 18 px; ocenie podlega przede wszystkim sylwetka.

sheet.labels: No text. Eight rows follow images array order; left column 18 px, right 36 px. Bottom floor: ammo_shells left and ammo_rounds right, each 48 px. Inspect sheet at 100 percent scale.

visual_review.icon_18px: All silhouettes distinguishable on parchment. Vow flask seal reduces to a small ochre accent; fine indentation and material texture do not survive at 18 px.
visual_review.icon_36px: Seal, wing, fuse, shield and heart are clear.
visual_review.ammo_48px: Loose three-shell pile and compact tied packet are distinct and visible on actual floor crop.
visual_review.in_engine_6_to_8_m: Not tested; no integration or game code changes.
visual_review.text_skulls_gloss: No text or skulls. Revolver cartridge highlights were removed with imagegen edit.
